author_layer.excluded: Shared chassis, upstream SVG assets, selfcheck, source audit and license files.

size.target: Readable full accepted at 15,236 characters after correcting host-safe listener ownership.

measurements.description: Compact/minified: JavaScript is one 5,296-character line and HTML/CSS is six lines.
Fully expanded semantic implementation; rejected for token cost.
Named model/functions, 303-line JavaScript, rule-per-line CSS and host-safe input/lifecycle ownership.

size.reason: Going below this value without removing interruption/lifecycle behavior or returning to minified expression chains would violate the readability and zero-degradation constraints. The final pass preserves host event properties by using abortable listeners rather than assigning window.on* slots.

preserved_model.audio: Triangle oscillator, equal-tempered 440 Hz mapping, 12 ms attack, 2.4 s decay and 120 ms release are unchanged.

changes: Reformatted the six-line HTML/CSS as readable rule-per-line source without changing computed layout or styling.
Replaced one-letter minified state with named phase, round, notes, selection, clip, progress and marker variables.
Kept a single named update transition for select, nudge, check, transfer and reset; intervals and deviations remain derived from notes.
Kept pointer, piano-button keyboard activation, 24-key computer keyboard mapping, slot nudging and real touch on the same note transition.
Added pointercancel and lostpointercapture recovery with explicit capture release.
Owns and clears timers, animation frame, voices, captures and abortable listeners across reset, dispose, pagehide and idempotent reinit without replacing host event properties.
Exposes only the necessary window.MotifMatch lifecycle methods: init, reset and dispose.

visual_regression.comparison: 12 freshly generated baseline/candidate PNG pairs are byte-identical.

cross_audit.staging_fix: The prior candidate assigned window.onkeydown, onkeyup, onblur and onpagehide. It now binds all owned input and lifecycle events through a per-mount AbortController, so dispose is complete and existing host handlers survive init, dispose and reinit.
cross_audit.algorithm_check: Reference, error and transfer outcomes remain computed from current MIDI notes through interval and deviation vectors. No answer lookup or decorative-only state was introduced.
cross_audit.visual_check: The 12 stored baseline/candidate state pairs remain pixel-identical; the listener fix has no rendered output and the independent normal/reduced state snapshots match formal at both sizes.
cross_audit.fallback_check: The no-Audio run keeps note and interval evidence. Aborting all four auxiliary marker SVGs produces the four expected request/resource diagnostics while the complete success-transfer loop remains functional.

mini.basis: The improved full is 15,236 characters, 5,236 above the 10,000-character exemption.

risks: The candidate is 5,236 characters above the 10k mini threshold, so it still needs a separate mini if selected as an auxiliary sample.
Web Audio still depends on browser autoplay/audio support, but the visible fallback and all non-audio evidence remain intact.
The lifecycle API is intentionally staging-local and has no visual output.
